scope: Exact independently reviewed V10 position-2 evidence adapter and fixture tests

source_origin.publication_method: Reuse two-stage SHA-pinned source exports and freshly recheck live identities; copy bytes without implementation edits.

changes: Recognize only the retained legacy schema/kind or V10 fresh-traversal schema/kind, preserving normal validator invocation.
V10 adaptation checks official token embeddings, model checkpoint, complete layer order, independent oracle flags and KV parentage.
Fixture tests cover accepted V10 preparation and rejection of a mismatched schema/kind.
Existing public callers and CLI signatures remain unchanged; no RTL, oracle, vectors or expected values are modified by the publisher.

validation_boundary.original_independent_review: Reports focused checks passed and the former identity mismatch crossed without a new V3 execution.
validation_boundary.publisher_checks: Exact source SHA/size, full diff, Python syntax, retained prior repair SHA and unchanged public caller signatures.

excluded_from_publication: Raw model evidence, vectors, weights, sessions, credentials and live state
Native execution authority, claims and original review receipts
continuation_rule: Preserve the exact adapter and previous reviewed repairs. This closes only a source-format compatibility boundary, not V2 provenance or V3 trajectory/logits/oracle acceptance. Never replay consumed claims or overwrite a running workspace.
